propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope: none should remain certified after unrelated commits move HEAD, skipping whole-HEAD drift re-evaluation.

Empty dependency paths with effective scope none must classify as none and emit exactly one authenticated file-scope: none declaration; paths and unscoped scopes must serialize byte-identical to pre-feature output.
A none declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity; only authenticated manifest declarations are trusted.
Flipping file scope between none and paths or changing only no_file_impact_reason must yield stale-material verdict due to material fingerprint changes.
Legacy undeclared empty-impact attestations and unscoped records must continue to return stale-head after HEAD moves, preserving fail-closed behavior.
Public resign_plan_review recovery must preserve none scope through the signing boundary and authenticated manifest reader without new branches.
